meta.name: topic_routing
meta.title: Email topic routing
meta.description: Dev set for harness tuning: new items in the same style as the golden topic_routing set.

department.instructions: Which team must act on the main request in `email`?

criteria.billing: charges, invoices, subscription payments, refunds of money already paid
criteria.technical_support: a device or the app not working, setup, connectivity or firmware problems
criteria.sales: buying new products, quotes, bulk or business orders, pricing before purchase
criteria.account_access: logging in, passwords, two-factor codes, locked or hijacked accounts
criteria.shipping: where an order is, delivery delays, damaged or wrong items in a delivery, address changes for an order
criteria.privacy_legal: personal data requests, data deletion, GDPR or CCPA, legal notices, terms of service

tags.easy: clear-cut: the request and its team are stated plainly
tags.hard: needs care: boundary rules, distractor keywords, mixed topics or an implied need
tags.multi_topic: mentions two areas; the label is the team that must act on the main (explicit) request
tags.misleading_keyword: contains a strong keyword associated with a different team
tags.indirect: the need is implied rather than named

input.email:
Subject: Charged after cancelling

I cancelled Lumora Plus on 2 June and have the confirmation email, but my card was charged $6.99 again on 15 June. Please refund that charge.

rationale: Refund of a subscription payment taken after cancellation.

input.email:
Subject: Smart plug switching itself

My Lumora smart plug turns itself off and back on every few minutes. There's no schedule or automation set on it and the firmware is up to date.

rationale: A device misbehaving.

input.email:
Subject: Gift cards?

Do you sell gift cards? I'd like to get one for my sister's housewarming so she can choose her own devices.

rationale: Buying a new product.

input.email:
Subject: Which email did I sign up with?

I can't remember which email address I used to create my Lumora account, so I can't log in. Can you find the account using my phone number?

rationale: Cannot log in because the sign-in email is unknown.

input.email:
Subject: Held at customs

My order LM-60417 has shown 'held at customs' in Calais for nine days. What do I need to do to get it released and delivered?

rationale: A delivery delayed in transit.

input.email:
Subject: Export my data under GDPR

Under Article 20 of the GDPR I'd like a machine-readable export of my personal data, including my camera event history, so I can move it to another service.

rationale: Data portability request.

input.email:
Subject: Referees for Data Analyst role

After my final interview for the Data Analyst role, the recruiter asked for two referees. Should I send their contact details to this address or upload them to the candidate portal?

rationale: Hiring process question from a candidate.

input.email:
Subject: Downgrade at next renewal

I'd like to move from Plus Family to Plus Basic when my plan renews next month. Will the lower price apply from that billing date?

rationale: Changing a subscription plan and its price.

input.email:
Subject: Arrived perfect, now silent

My video doorbell arrived in perfect condition in January and chimed fine for months. Since the weekend the indoor chime stays silent, although the app still logs every button press.

rationale: Worked after arrival and then failed, so technical_support per the boundary rule despite mentioning arrival.

input.email:
Subject: Smart lock for a euro-cylinder door

I'm planning to buy the Lumora smart lock. Will it fit a UK euro-cylinder door, and what does it cost with the keypad add-on?

rationale: Compatibility and pricing before purchase.

input.email:
Subject: Passkey sign-in fails

On my new laptop the 'Sign in with passkey' option fails with 'no credentials available'. I don't have a password set. How do I log in?

rationale: Login problem.

input.email:
Subject: Soaked parcel, hub won't boot

The courier left my parcel in the rain overnight. The hub inside was wet through, smells burnt and won't boot at all. It never worked. Please send a replacement.

rationale: Sounds like a device fault, but it arrived damaged and a replacement is requested, so shipping per the boundary rule.

input.email:
Subject: Correct my date of birth

Your records have my date of birth wrong (it shows 1987, it should be 1978). Under GDPR I'm asking you to rectify my personal data.

rationale: Data rectification request.

input.email:
Subject: Speculative application - marketing

I can't see a marketing opening on your careers page, but I'd love to join Lumora's marketing team. My CV and portfolio are attached in case anything comes up.

rationale: Job application.

input.email:
Subject: Still charging an account I abandoned

I lost access to my old Lumora account two years ago and I don't want it back. The problem is it's still charging my card $4.99 a month. Please stop the subscription and refund the last three months.

rationale: Mentions losing account access, but the explicit ask is stopping and refunding subscription charges, not regaining the account.

input.email:
Subject: She looked asleep

Third night running, the nursery camera's picture froze on a single frame around 2am. We only realised because we could hear the baby crying while the screen still showed her asleep.

rationale: Describes a camera feed freezing without naming it as a support request.

input.email:
Subject: Support plan for 12 clinics

We're a dental group about to buy cameras and hubs for 12 clinics. Before we sign off, what would your premium support plan cost on top of the hardware, per site?

rationale: Mentions support, but it's pre-purchase pricing for a business order.

input.email:
Subject: Login code delivery is too slow

Your login codes are delivered to my email about 20 minutes after I request them, and by then they've expired. I haven't been able to sign in for three days.

rationale: 'Delivered' suggests shipping, but the problem is login verification codes.

input.email:
Subject: Moving to Dublin on Friday

My thermostat order still hasn't shipped and I move to Dublin on Friday. Nobody will be at the old flat after Thursday.

rationale: Implies a delivery delay and an address change for an order without stating a request.

input.email:
Subject: Passport photo from account recovery

When I recovered my account last month, your support agent asked for a photo of my passport. I'm back in now, so please delete that image and tell me who had access to it.

rationale: Mentions account recovery, but access is restored and the explicit ask is deleting personal data.

input.email:
Subject: Billing Operations Analyst - salary band

I've applied for the Billing Operations Analyst role and have a first interview next week. Could you share the salary band for the position before then?

rationale: 'Billing' is the role name; it's a question from a job candidate.
